# Vendor backend service status and routing (his-vendor-backend)

**Goal:** the technical surface of his-vendor-backend (module [B06](../../modules/B-vendor.md#b06)) stays safe to operate: a liveness probe the load balancer can trust, a Swagger UI for integrators, and clean 404/405 answers that never leak internals.

**Docs:** test doc [vendor-backend-testing.md](../../vendor-backend-testing.md) · module features: [module catalogue](../../modules/README.md) (linked on every story).

Source cluster `V-SYS`: `his-v3-ai/services-impl/202611/backend-rest-e2e-qa-assessment/vendor-backend/V-SYS/` — `USER-STORIES.md` (stories), `USER-SCENARIOS.md` (scenarios),
`TEST-CASES.md` + `cases.json` (cases). Module features: see the links on each story and

## User stories

- **US-VSYS-01** ([B06.01](../../modules/B-vendor.md#f-b06-01)) — Liveness probe service-status (source: `US-V-SYS-01`)
- **US-VSYS-02** ([B06.02](../../modules/B-vendor.md#f-b06-02)) — Swagger UI tersedia untuk developer (source: `US-V-SYS-02`)
- **US-VSYS-03** ([B06.03](../../modules/B-vendor.md#f-b06-03)) — Router mengembalikan 404/405 yang bersih untuk route invalid (source: `US-V-SYS-03`)

## Test scenarios

From `USER-SCENARIOS.md` of the source cluster (one row per scenario; flows summarised, not changed).

| Scenario    | Story      | Feature | Given / When / Then (main flow · alternate / exception)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      | Test cases                                         |
| ----------- | ---------- | ------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ | -------------------------------------------------- |
| SC-V-SYS-01 | US-VSYS-01 | B06.01  | Given the service is up, when a probe (Kubernetes, Nginx, monitoring) sends `GET /api/v1/service-status` without any header, then it gets HTTP 200 with a JSON body and marks the node healthy · while booting: 503 or refused → unhealthy · timeout/refused → unhealthy without reading the body            | TC-VSYS-001, TC-VSYS-002                           |
| SC-V-SYS-02 | US-VSYS-02 | B06.02  | Given Swagger is enabled, when a developer opens `GET /api/v1/swagger/index.html`, then the Swagger UI HTML lists the documented endpoints · Swagger disabled by config: `/swagger/*` → 404 · unknown file `GET /swagger/nonexistent-file` → 404 without panic or stack trace                                | TC-VSYS-004, TC-VSYS-005                           |
| SC-V-SYS-03 | US-VSYS-03 | B06.03  | Given the service is up, when a client calls an unregistered path `GET /api/v1/nonexistent`, then it gets HTTP 404 with no stack trace or internal data · wrong method on an existing route (`DELETE /api/v1/service-status`) → 405 · a 404/405 body containing `goroutine` or `panic` is a security finding | TC-VSYS-003, TC-VSYS-006, TC-VSYS-007, TC-VSYS-008 |
